Stage.description:
The pipeline stages an audit record can carry.

Ordered as the architecture runs them: telemetry → detection → state
estimation → hypotheses → physics/safety validation → recommendation. The
LLM sits between evidence gathering and validation, and is recorded as one
stage among several rather than as the pipeline.
Stage.title: Stage

StageStatus.description: Outcome of a stage. The distinctions here are the point of the enum.
StageStatus.title: StageStatus

description:
One append-only entry in a run's log.

Frozen. The store has no update path and the database aborts UPDATE, so an
entry is immutable at three levels: the object, the API, and the schema.

actor.description: SYSTEM for pipeline output, OPERATOR for a human decision

duration_ms.description: Measured wall-clock duration of the stage. None when the stage did not execute, so a NOT_IMPLEMENTED stage cannot report a runtime.
duration_ms.title: Duration Ms

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the entry was written
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

summary.description: One line an operator can read without opening the payload
summary.title: Summary
